name: {vendorname}/{vendor-prefix}-module-{modulename}-tools-openemr
description: OpenEMR source tree for static analysis (PHPStan) and the local Docker bind mount. Pinned to the public upstream openemr/openemr rel-810 branch (OpenEMR 8.1) so analysis resolves the Symfony-Session CsrfUtils API the module targets, with no private-repo credential needed. Not a runtime dependency of the module. See tools/openemr/README.md.
